description.value: Bayview Garden is a small oceanfront guesthouse in K'il Kun - Sandspit on Moresby Island, the only community on Moresby Island and the gateway to Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve. Built around a WWII-era military police building from the Alliford Bay Seaplane base, it offers private rooms in a shared facility with a fully equipped guest kitchen and common lounge areas overlooking Shingle Bay. The owner, Flavien, is himself a cycling enthusiast and manages the local Visitor Centre, making this a well-connected base for exploring Haida Gwaii.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the website content fetched from bayviewgarden.ca, which is detailed and current (references 2025 and 2026 dates). The website explicitly addresses many amenity questions (no laundry service, no breakfast, free Wi-Fi, luggage storage for a fee, shared kitchen, no room keys). Bike-specific storage is not mentioned anywhere on the site despite a dedicated Storage page; the storage offering described is for luggage/gear bags, not explicitly bikes. OSM tags match the website's phone number and street address, confirming contact details.
concerns: OSM address lacks city and postal code; website provides full address as '401 Beach Road, Sandspit, BC V0T 1T0' — used website version.
OSM community field is 'Unknown / North Coast & Haida Gwaii'; actual community is Sandspit, Haida Gwaii.
No mention of secure bike storage anywhere on the website despite a dedicated Storage page — the storage described is for luggage/gear bags, not bicycles specifically.
Website references 'this year (2026)' on the Food page while also referencing 'summer 2024' for the same restaurant, suggesting some content may be copy-pasted from prior years without full update.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Bayview Garden is a legitimate, active guesthouse in a remote and compelling cycling destination (Haida Gwaii / Gwaii Haanas gateway), but it cannot be confirmed as WWC-compliant because secure overnight bike storage — the primary required criterion — is not mentioned anywhere on the website. A follow-up inquiry to confirm bike storage arrangements is needed before including.
enrichment_extras.notes: The owner (Flavien) is described as a cycling enthusiast who explores the world by bicycle and manages the Sandspit Visitor Centre. The See & Do page actively promotes cycling including a 15 km ride to the ferry terminal. Despite this cycling-friendly culture, no explicit bike storage amenity is documented on the site — a direct inquiry would likely resolve the required criteria quickly.

Laundry.detail: Website states: 'We do not provide a laundry service. However, there is a coin operated [laundromat]' — implying coin-op laundry exists elsewhere in town, but none on-site

Early or packed breakfast.detail: Website states: 'Breakfast is not included' and 'there are no early breakfast options anywhere in town, and cooking your own breakfast will be your only option if you leave early on a tour.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Food page lists multiple in-town options: Clubhouse Restaurant and Café (golf course), Beaches Restaurant at Northern Shores Lodging, Raincoast Breads (by reservation), and Shingle Bay Bistro at the airport terminal

Nearby grocery.detail: Website mentions Fresh Mart (formerly Super Valu) local grocery store and K'il Kun Convenience store on School Rd, close to Bayview Garden

Luggage storage.detail: Website states: 'For all our guests going on a tour, we can store your luggage for you, for a fee.' Guest review (2024) confirms: 'For a small fee, we stored our surplus luggage here when we went on our kayak trip.'

Wi-Fi.detail: Website states: 'Wi-Fi is available at the Bayview Garden, at no extra cost.' island data capacity and slow connection speeds are flagged

wow_evidence: owner, Flavien, is himself a cycling enthusiast and manages the local Visitor Centre
